tools.name: generate_names
tools.description: Generate random personal names typical of one or more countries (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Output is synthetic: for fiction, placeholders and test data. Not for impersonation or identity verification. On the paid remote server: pass a prepaid 'token' (from buy_pack) to get names directly; without a token

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: List supported regions with locale and name order.

tools.name: buy_pack
tools.description: Get the price and payment instructions for a prepaid pack of queries (sizes 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000). One x402 payment returns a token; 1 credit = 1 region in one generate_names call. This tool does not pay by itself.

tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Show the remaining credits of a prepaid token.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "generate_names" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Generate random personal names typical of a country/region (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Output is synthetic: for fiction, placeholders and test data. Not for impersonation or identity verification. On the paid remote server this returns the price and the exact URL to pay via x402 (USDC); pay= sets a pay-wh" → after: "Generate random personal names typical of one or more countries (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Output is synthetic: for fiction, placeholders and test data. Not for impersonation or identity verification. On the paid remote server: pass a prepaid 'token' (from buy_pack) to get names directly; without a token"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
